business_problem: KABAM Robotics wanted to make its service robots more intelligent and useful across security, facilities, and hospitality settings while keeping experimentation fast and model deployment affordable.
solution_summary: KABAM Robotics built its Smart+ cloud robot-management platform and REMI intelligence layer on AWS to improve the concierge and operational abilities of service robots deployed across four continents. Amazon Bedrock gives the team fast access to large language models through APIs so it can experiment and choose the right model behavior for robot interactions. Amazon SageMaker is used to deploy open-source vision-capable models such as Llava, Amazon EKS provides the managed Kubernetes environment for cloud-side robot services, and Amazon Polly adds voice capabilities for more natural interactions. This stack lets KABAM combine generative AI, deployed models, orchestration, and speech into a single robot platform rather than maintaining specialized hardware for each function. The result is faster experimentation, lower model-operating cost, and more capable robots for customer-facing environments.
